definition: Mirella Lapata is a computer scientist and Professor in the School of Informatics at the University of Edinburgh.
details: Working on the general problem of extracting semantic information from large bodies of text, Lapata develops computer algorithms and models in the field of natural language processing (NLP).
story: Imagine explaining a hard concept to a friend using nothing but a napkin and a pen. A small key that opens a much bigger door. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. A small mental model that makes a big tangle suddenly simple. That is Mirella Lapata — a small key that opens a big door.
